social_circle.name: Denise Johnson

demographics.occupation: retired medical billing and coding specialist
demographics.education: Some college and a medical billing/coding certificate

background.how_they_met: Denise is Miranda's mother and raised her in the Cleveland area with Miranda's father, Robert.
background.why_close: They are emotionally close, talk almost every day, share faith and family routines, and Denise shaped Miranda's emphasis on education, preparation, and knowing the numbers.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in complete sentences with practical questions, reminders, and occasional prayerful encouragement. She moves quickly from empathy to solutions.

shared_activities: near-daily after-work calls or texts while Miranda makes dinner
medical portal and insurance paperwork help
recent_text_topics: Denise's diabetes-related appointment and whether follow-up paperwork or portal messages need attention.
Sunday dinner plans, including who is bringing what and whether Miranda is baking sweet-potato pie.
Checking whether Miranda is resting enough during her work rollout and PMP study weeks.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Miranda's mother Denise lives in the Cleveland area and they 'talk almost every day, usually after work while I am making dinner.' Q35 says Miranda helps her mom with appointments, portal messages, medication questions, and insurance letters. Q101-Q103 describe Denise's medical billing/coding background.

social_circle.name: Keisha Walker

background.how_they_met: Keisha met Miranda in college, where they bonded as Black women balancing school, ambition, faith, and family expectations.
background.why_close: Keisha is Miranda's first call when something is bothering her; she gives Miranda space to vent without immediately trying to manage the situation.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts conversationally with humor, affirmations, reaction GIFs, and quick check-ins. She uses emojis and will send a voice note when the topic is too layered to type.

shared_activities: talking through stress and family concerns
recent_text_topics: Miranda calling after a rough Zumba night when the digital workflow rollout and her mother's appointment overwhelmed her.
Boundary-setting jokes about Miranda needing to stop giving a 'full legal brief' when saying no.
Planning a low-key brunch or cooking night after a packed work and coaching week.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Keisha as one of Miranda's closest friends from college and says Miranda calls Keisha first when something is really bothering her. Q44 says Miranda called Keisha after struggling emotionally with a work rollout and her mother's diabetes-related appointment.

social_circle.name: Marcus Johnson

demographics.education: Associate degree and technical maintenance certifications

background.how_they_met: Marcus is Miranda's older brother; they grew up together in Parma with both parents.
background.why_close: They share family history, Cleveland roots, Sunday dinners, practical caregiving for their parents, and coordination around his children.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts short, practical messages, often about logistics. Uses humor, sports commentary, and quick confirmations more than long emotional paragraphs.

shared_activities: niece and nephew games or performances
recent_text_topics: Whether Miranda can be backup for a school pickup, game, or project for her niece and nephew.
Coordinating help for their parents, with Marcus handling more physical tasks and rides while Miranda handles paperwork.
Cavs commentary and teasing about his son's basketball habits.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 identifies Marcus as Miranda's older brother with two kids and says she sees his family two or three times a month. Q19 says Miranda helps with school pickup only as backup if Marcus and Tasha are stuck. Q35 says Marcus helps with their parents, especially physical tasks and rides.

social_circle.name: Tasha Johnson

background.how_they_met: Tasha became Miranda's sister-in-law through Marcus and is the mother of Miranda's niece and nephew.
background.why_close: They coordinate around the children, family gatherings, school projects, rides, and practical support. Tasha trusts Miranda as a reliable aunt.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts clearly and efficiently, often with schedules, screenshots, and reminders. Friendly but usually multitasking.

recent_text_topics: Schedules for the nephew's basketball games and the niece's art club or choir events.
Asking whether Miranda can help with a school project or provide a backup ride.
Planning dishes for family gatherings and making sure Miranda does not overcommit.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Miranda is close to her sister-in-law Tasha and her niece and nephew. Q06 also says she helps with rides, games, and school projects when Marcus and Tasha need backup. Q19 describes the niece's art club and choir and nephew's basketball.

social_circle.name: Lauren Mitchell

demographics.education: Master's degree in library and information science

background.how_they_met: Lauren met Miranda through book club and became one of her closest friends through shared reading, community events, and regular social plans.
background.why_close: They connect over books, civic-minded conversation, food, art festivals, and the kind of scheduled social life Miranda prefers.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in polished but casual sentences, sends book links and screenshots, and uses dry humor. Less emoji-heavy than Keisha but quick with a clever aside.

recent_text_topics: Choosing the next mystery novel for book club and joking about Miranda staying up too late reading.
Planning an art festival outing or brunch after church schedules settle.
Discussing Savannah travel ideas, local Black-owned businesses, and recipes for a book club dinner.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Lauren as one of Miranda's closest friends and says Lauren is in her book club. Q07 also lists book club, brunch, Cavs watch parties, art festivals, and cooking at someone's house as shared friend activities. Q15 and Q32 show Miranda reads mystery novels and sometimes stays up late reading.
